subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer noted a series of naturally formed shelves that tiered the cavern walls, creating ledges and recesses along its perimeter.
source_quote: He noted a series of naturally formed shelves that tiered the cavern walls, creating ledges and recesses along its perimeter.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer noted that dominating the center of the cavern was a substantial rocky mesa, a raised plateau that formed a distinct feature within the immense space.
source_quote: Dominating the center of the cavern was a substantial rocky mesa, a raised plateau that formed a distinct feature within the immense space.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer noted that crude but functional ramps snaked their way up the sides of the mesa, connecting its various levels.
source_quote: Adding to this subterranean spectacle were several shafts of pure white light, piercing down from unseen openings far above, casting ethereal beams across the vast expanse. These ramps led upwards to the height of the mesa's two topmost tiers, which, remarkably, were linked by a sturdy bridge that spanned the distance between them.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer thought, 'The egg,' as his eyes locked onto a large, distinctly red egg that rested atop one of the mesa's highest tiers.
source_quote: A thought escaped his lips, almost a reverent whisper: 'The egg.' His eyes had locked onto a large, distinctly red egg that rested atop one of the mesa's highest tiers.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer sensed the egg’s corruption from afar.
source_quote: And even from afar, he can sense it’s corruption.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer exclaimed, 'The obelisk,' as he observed a towering structure standing sentinel on the second tier.
source_quote: Shifting his gaze to the adjacent topmost tier, another exclamation followed, this time a statement of observation: 'The obelisk.' Standing sentinel on this second tier was a towering structure, a fifty-foot-tall obelisk crafted from a smooth, jet-black metal.

subject: the explorer
fact: The explorer noticed that the obelisk had noticeable imperfections marring its otherwise flawless surface, appearing as though small fragments had been chipped away over time.
source_quote: Upon closer inspection, he could discern a few noticeable imperfections marring its otherwise flawless surface, appearing as though small fragments had been somehow chipped away over time.

subject: the female derro
fact: The female derro stood close to the black metal, gently patting and stroking its cool surface with an almost reverent touch.
source_quote: Her actions were curious; she stood close to the black metal, gently patting and stroking its cool surface with an almost reverent touch.

subject: the obelisk
fact: The obelisk emitted a brief flash of light, a pulse that caused the ambient glow of the faerzress within the cavern to momentarily flare in response.
source_quote: Suddenly, the obelisk emitted a brief flash of light, a pulse that caused the ambient glow of the faerzress within the cavern to momentarily flare in response, intensifying the eerie illumination.

subject: the female derro
fact: The female derro reacted with a sharp squeal of glee at the obelisk's flash.
source_quote: The derro reacted with a sharp squeal of glee at this display.

subject: the female derro
fact: The female derro bent down and snatched an object from the ground near the obelisk.
source_quote: Immediately following the flash, she bent down and snatched an object from the ground near the obelisk.

subject: the female derro
fact: The female derro produced a small notebook and began to diligently write something within its pages, her brow furrowed in concentration.
source_quote: With the object now in hand, she produced a small notebook and began to diligently write something within its pages, her brow furrowed in concentration.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum coughed, 'I am a cleric of Bahamut, and I am drawn to this egg.'
source_quote: Grygum coughs, 'I am a cleric of Bahamut, and I am drawn to this egg.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum pointed to the egg.
source_quote: He points to the egg.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki looked at Grygum, confused.
source_quote: Plinki looks at him, confused.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki became excited and said, 'A cleric of Bahamut to see my creation! Excellent! Then it has worked!'
source_quote: But something about his demeanor made her excited, 'A cleric of Bahamut to see my creation! Excellent! Then it has worked!'

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki shouted, 'Come here!'
source_quote: She shouts, 'Come here!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum circled the mesa, found a ramp in the back, and started to climb.
source_quote: Grygum circles the mesa, finds a ramp in the back, and starts to climb.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed that Thorin, Daz, and Grygum followed him from a distance.
source_quote: As he walks, he notices that Thorin, Daz, and Grygum follow him from a distance.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki ignored their presence and motioned to several other Derro to come to the egg.
source_quote: Plinki is ignoring their presence. Instead, she motions to several other Derro to come to the egg.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum counted the Derro and said, 'six.'
source_quote: Grygum counts them, 'six.'

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki pointed to Grygum’s friends and asked, 'Who are they?'
source_quote: Once standing in front of the egg, Plinki points to Grygum’s friends and asks, 'Who are they?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said, 'They are my companions. They are not as enlightened as I.'
source_quote: They are my companions. They are not as enlightened as I.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt the egg’s evil.
source_quote: Grygum looks at the egg, and can feel its evil.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked, 'Tell me about this egg?'
source_quote: Tell me about this egg?

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki said, 'The Grey Ghosts stole it from the Keepers of the Flame. And then I brought it here. I have been using this magical artifact to infuse it with the spirit of a demon in honor of Demogorgon.'
source_quote: The Grey Ghosts stole it from the Keepers of the Flame. And then I brought it here. I have been using this magical artifact to infuse it with the spirit of a demon in honor of Demogorgon.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes that Dragons have freedom of choice, and thus there is no good or evil dragon because of its scales, but goodness and evil flow from the choices of dragons.
source_quote: Grygum believes that Dragons have freedom of choice. And thus, for Grygum, there is no good or evil dragon because of its scales, but goodness and evil flow from the choices of dragons.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed that Plinki had gotten closer and that the other Derro had surrounded him.
source_quote: As Grygum reflects on this, he also notices that Plinki has gotten closer and that the other Derro have surrounded him.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum was not surprised when Plinki declared, 'The beating heart of a cleric of Bahamut will seal the ritual!'
source_quote: So when Plinki declares, 'The beating heart of a cleric of Bahamut will seal the ritual!' He’s not surprised.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum shouted, 'The Drow hates dragons and will destroy the egg if you do not back down!'
source_quote: Grygum shouts, 'The Drow hates dragons and will destroy the egg if you do not back down!'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin shouted, 'What would a dragon omelet taste like? And would this one have two yolks?'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, 'What would a dragon omelet taste like? And would this one have two yolks?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir enveloped the entire top tier in his magical darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir has enveloped the entire top tier in his magical darkness.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard the thuds of Zalthir’s fists on the crazed Derro.
source_quote: Grygum hears the thuds of Zalthir’s fists on the crazed Derro.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki shouted, 'Let me go!'
source_quote: Plinki shouts, 'Let me go!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum smiled as Plinki was grappled.
source_quote: Plinki has been grappled. And since he is grappled, Grygum will show him the true power of Bahamut.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum uttered words of cruel power and raked his hand through the air before Plinki.
source_quote: He utters words of cruel power, rakes his hand through the air before Plinki.

subject: Grygum
fact: Magic followed, forming a great claw that glimmered in the air for the blink of an eye.
source_quote: Magic follows, forming a great claw that glimmers in the air for the blink of an eye.

subject: Grygum
fact: The necromancy sought to rend armor, unstitch flesh, crush bone—to do whatever it must to destroy your enemy.
source_quote: This necromancy seeks to rend armor, unstitch flesh, crush bone—to do whatever it must to destroy your enemy.
